description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'Tasks' for managing database installation tasks in Drupal, including testing database capabilities, version checks, and connection validation.

classes.name: Tasks
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods for database installation and validation tasks in Drupal.

methods.name: installable
methods.description: Checks if the database supports PDO driver and has no errors, indicating Drupal can be installed.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Abstract method to return the human-readable name of the database driver.

methods.name: minimumVersion
methods.description: Returns the minimum required database engine version, default is NULL.

methods.name: runTasks
methods.description: Runs a series of database tests and tasks to verify Drupal's database compatibility.

methods.name: engineVersionRequirementsCheck
methods.description: Checks if the database engine version meets the minimum requirements.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attempts to establish a database connection and reports success or failure.

methods.name: runTestQuery
methods.description: Executes a test query on the database and reports success or failure.

methods.name: checkEngineVersion
methods.description: Verifies the database engine version against the minimum required version.

methods.name: getFormOptions
methods.description: Provides configuration form options for database connection settings.

methods.name: validateDatabaseSettings
methods.description: Validates database configuration settings, such as table prefix.

methods.name: isConnectionActive
methods.description: Checks if there is an active database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current database connection object.

methods.name: checkJsonSupport
methods.description: Checks if the database connection supports JSON data type.
